chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-'Ala, from Abi Basir, from Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever frequently recites Surah Al-Qiyamah and acts upon it, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will raise him from his grave with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) in the best form. He will be given glad tidings and smile in his face until he passes over the Sirat and the Mizan.

key_terms.الصِّرَاط: The bridge over Hellfire that all must cross on Judgment Day
key_terms.بَعَثَهُ: He will raise him (from the grave)
key_terms.وَالْمِيزَانِ: The Scales used to weigh deeds on the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for frequently reciting Surah Al-Qiyamah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration in *Thawab al-Amal*, emphasizing the transformative power of consistent recitation and application of Surah Al-Qiyamah. The hadith promises that the faithful will be resurrected in the 'best form' alongside the Prophet, with divine pleasure manifesting as a smile, ensuring a smooth crossing of the Sirat and Mizan. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the intercessory role of the Prophet and the tangible spiritual benefits of engaging with Quranic chapters.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from al-Hussain b. Abi al-’Ala from Abi Basir from Abi Ja’far (a.s.) who said:

Whoever recites Surah Qiyamat regularly and acts upon it, Allah would raise him from the grave with the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.s.) in the best form. He would be given glad-tiding and he would pass through Sirat and Mizan smiling.
